By examining the code snippet for `pandas.core.arrays.timedeltas.TimedeltaArray._addsub_offset_array`, which is the method called during this operation, we observe a try-except block that raises a TypeError when trying to perform the operation with non-tick DateOffset objects. This suggests that the subtraction operation might be encountering incompatible objects, leading to an unexpected TimedeltaArray being returned instead of an Index object.
